description: This file defines the NoteViewGridHolder class, a custom ViewHolder for displaying note items in a grid layout within an Android application. It manages UI binding, styling, and interaction logic for note display components.

classes.name: NoteViewGridHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying note items in a grid layout, handling UI binding, styling, and user interactions.

methods.name: NoteViewGridHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with binding, click listener, font style, and size.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Method that throws an exception indicating swipe actions are not supported for grid view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to the UI components, including category, status, favorite, title, and excerpt, and manages visibility.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns null, indicating swipe actions are not applicable.
